Kaccaññaḥ. 249. Rū. 266. Moga, 4. 99. Nīti, sutta. 494 - See.]. (1) In that object (or) status = Bhummattha. (2) In that status or issue = Niddhāraṇattha. (3) To that place or object = Kammattha. (4) (A) To that place or object = Lakkhaṇavantakammattha. (B) If it happens like that =  Bhāvalakkhaṇattha. (5) Therefore (or) Due to that status or object = Nimittattha. (6) Of that object or status = Sāmyattha.
